title: A closed-loop platform engineers enzymes with minimal human input
summary: Machine learning and language models choosing variants, with a biofoundry running build and test, raised Arabidopsis halide methyltransferase substrate preference 90-fold (16-fold ethyltransferase activity) and Yersinia mollaretii phytase activity 26-fold at neutral pH, in four rounds over four weeks and under 500 variants per enzyme. Two enzymes only; the amount of human setup was not checked in the full text.
ai_technology: Machine learning and LLM-guided variant design with biofoundry automation

evidence.tested: Proof of concept on two enzymes over four rounds in four weeks, under 500 variants per enzyme: about 90-fold substrate preference gain for AtHMT and 26-fold activity gain for YmPhytase at neutral pH.
evidence.unknown: Only two enzymes were tested; the abstract does not describe any remaining human role beyond the input sequence and fitness metric, and states no limitations.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning and language models chose protein variants, with biofoundry automation building and testing them.
